description: A test script designed to verify the colorization and output formatting of remote messages in a Git client, including setup, keyword highlighting, color decoding, and various configuration scenarios.

methods.name: test_hook
methods.description: Sets up test environment, including repository creation, commits, and cloning, and executes command sequences for testing.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution, running specific Git commands and verifying colorized output.

methods.name: test_decode_color
methods.description: Decodes colorized output into a readable format for verification.
